notes.title: Hotfix 0.1.2.5 - Crash reports processing
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the teleportation anomaly animation update caused crashes.
[*] Fixed a conflict caused by visibility flags for holdable items.
[*] Fixed a crash that occurred when the dynamic enemy spawner queue failed to find a valid spawn location.
[*] Fixed a crash where the player character on clients could not retrieve global gameplay parameters.
[*] Fixed an issue where the flare gun triggered the reload animation twice.
[*] Fixed a crash caused by attempting to use a holdable item while it was invalid.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.1.2.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*]  Addressed crash reports
[*]  Removed the ability to run while crouched
[*]  Increased the base volume of voice chat audio playback
[*]  Fixed a situation where the game allowed joining an already started session
[*]  Changes have been made to environmental elements related to navigation through quest zones
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.1.2.1 - Environment & Stability Update
notes.content:
[h2]Stability & Optimization[/h2]
[list]
[*] Continued work on crash reports
[*] Partial optimization of loading and rendering resources of the game world in order to improve frame rate stability
[*] Reworked graphics settings presets (High and lower) to improve performance while maintaining visual fidelity
[/list]

[h2]Environment & Navigation[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved spawn placement of lanterns in the backcountry
[*] Laid out new paths, adjusted landscape, and removed excess vegetation for better navigation
[*] Fine-tuned quest bubble visibility and placement
[*] Fence and gate placement adjustments for consistency
[/list]

[h2]UI & Inventory Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug causing inventory block with first aid kits
[*] The tooltip widget is now displayed correctly
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.1.1.11
notes.content:
[h2]Crash Handling[/h2]
Addressed crash reports, including issues related to player respawning.

[h2]Day/Night Cycle[/h2]
Improved and partially optimized transitions between day and night for smoother gameplay.

[h2]Navigation & Task Zones[/h2]
Implementation of territory restrictions based on task zones to help guide players and reduce the chance of getting lost (work in progress).

notes.title: Hotfix 0.1.1.8 - Stability & Improvements Update
notes.content:
[h2]Crash Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed crashes caused by the dynamic appearance of enemies
[*] Fixed crashes during transitions from the forest to backstage areas due to physics simulation issues
[/list]

[h2]Voice & Communication:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed interruptions in voice chat
[*] Increased voice playback distance for clearer co-op communication
[/list]

[h2]General Fixes & Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Partial optimization of interaction markers on interactive objects
[*] Improved visibility of quest-related elements for better guidance and progression
[*] Resolved errors related to writing data into save files
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.1.1.6
notes.content:
[h2]Patch note:[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Fixed an issue where the walkie-talkie would only activate for the player holding it (client-side only).
[*] Resolved a bug causing the walkie-talkie to malfunction in Voice Activation mode after disabling the jammer.
[/olist]

notes.title: Next Fest Steam 2025 – Our Demo is Live!
notes.content:
The BodyRecords demo is now available! Experience the intense cooperative extraction horror with a bodycam perspective, eerie liminal spaces, and microphone sensitivity.

Join us in Steam Next Fest February 2025 and let us know your thoughts! Your feedback is crucial in shaping the final game.

And for those who already participated in the demo and playtest - huge thank you! 
Your feedback has been invaluable in helping us improve the game! 🙌

notes.title: We’re thrilled to announce the release of the BodyRecords demo! 🎮
notes.content:
🚨 Exciting News! 🚨

We’re thrilled to announce the release of the BodyRecords demo! 🎮

With this, we’re closing the playtest. A huge thank you to everyone who participated and provided feedback – your input has been invaluable in improving the game! 🙌
